stem.en: Which statement about where the sixteen mahājanapadas lay is correct?

text.en: They were spread evenly over the whole subcontinent, with about four in each region.
Most lay in the north-west and the Ganga plain, and only a few lay south of the Yamuna.
Most lay in the far south, with only a few on the Ganga plain.
They lay along the coast, because each one depended on the sea.

explanation.en: Most of the sixteen lay in the north-west and along the Ganga plain. Only Chedi, Avanti and Aśhmaka lay south of the Yamuna. The kingdoms of Tamilakam in the far south were not among the sixteen.

hints.en: Think of Magadha, Kosala and Kāśhī, and of the river they lay near.
Aśhmaka was the farthest south of the sixteen, and it lay in the Deccan.
